subject: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M

Alex — great to meet you and Sarah on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps to keep momentum: 

1) Recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: conversational agent (customer support + guided workflows) + embeddings for semantic search + a small reranking pipeline for recommended results.
- Expected average prompt/response length: 120 tokens per chat interaction; embeddings ~ 1k tokens per document (batching for indexing), rerank calls are short (~50 tokens).

2) Ask / info we need to qualify pricing and model mix:
- Monthly token volume ranges (low/likely/high) by workload (chat / embeddings / rerank) — ballpark is fine.
- Target unit economics: target $/1M tokens (what’s in your procurement budget range?).
- Any constraints on model family (need state-of-the-art completions vs. smaller Llama-style models for cost)?

3) Our proposal outline / next steps:
- I’ll share a baseline pricing estimate and a recommended model mix (hosted vs dedicated sizing) — attached is a one-page MAP to align on key milestones.
- If we get token volumes + target $/1M, I can run a few model-mix simulations and come back with a 3-tier proposal (PoC / Pilot / Prod).
- Next meeting: pricing review / alignment (30–45 min).

Please send the rough monthly token ranges for chat / embeddings / rerank and your target $/1M (or a budget band). I’ve attached the mutual action plan (MAP) and would love to get that filled in so we can scope Dedicated sizing if needed.

Thanks — talk soon.

— Marissa

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@brightlayer.io>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick answers from our side so you can run the numbers: 

- Preliminary monthly token volume (estimates, low/likely/high):
  * Chat (customer support agent): 10M / 35M / 75M tokens
  * Embeddings (semantic search + vector DB): 5M / 18M / 50M tokens (note: these are mostly one-time indexing + incremental updates but we also have search-time embeddings for similarity)
  * Rerank (recommendation rerank calls): 500k / 2M / 6M tokens

- Target $/1M tokens: our procurement asked for a target of roughly $150 / 1M as a reference point — flexible if you can show better unit economics at scale.

- Model constraints: for customer-facing chat we need near-production quality (safety & helpfulness), but we are open to a hybrid approach: smaller quantized chat models for lower-cost queries and a higher-capability model for escalation/long-form answers. Embeddings can be lower-cost models if quality meets our similarity benchmarks.

I attached a spreadsheet with the volume buckets. Happy to hop back on a quick call to walk through the assumptions.

— Alex
Alex Johnson | Head of AI Engineering
BrightLayer
Attachment: token_volumes.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — token volumes and target $/1M

Alex — this is perfect, thanks for the ranges and the target. I did a quick pass with the team (attached one-pager) with two model-mix scenarios to hit your $150 / 1M target vs. a higher-quality mix: 

Scenario A — Cost-optimized (target ~$150 / 1M)
- Chat: 70% of tokens on a quantized chat model (low-cost), 30% routed to higher-capability model for escalations (effective blended unit cost)
- Embeddings: 100% on mid-cost embedding model, batch indexing to amortize costs
- Rerank: small rerank model, optimized batching
- Result: estimated blended $/1M ≈ $140–$160 depending on sequence lengths and caching benefits

Scenario B — Quality-first (blended ~$250 / 1M)
- Chat: 50% high-capability model, 50% mid-capacity model
- Embeddings: higher-quality embedding model for better semantic recall
- Rerank: same as above
- Result: estimated blended $/1M ≈ $230–$270

Notes / levers to bring costs down:
- Prefix/KV caching for chat to reduce repeated context costs
- Intelligent routing: keep short queries on cheaper models; escalate stateful/long-form to the top-tier model
- Dedicated Reserved capacity (Committed monthly) can materially reduce unit costs for steady volumes — we can model Dedicated vs. Hosted in the next pass

Next steps I propose: 
- I’ll schedule a 30-min pricing alignment with Rishi (technical SRE sizing) and our solutions engineer Priyom to run dedicated sizing assumptions and show Dedicated vs Hosted unit economics.
- If you’re comfortable, please sign off on the MAP milestones so we can commit calendar availability on my side.

Attaching: redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf (one-page blended model mix estimates)

Talk soon — available Tues/Wed morning PST for a 30-min pricing review.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_pricing_estimate.pdf

Quick internal note — forwarding Alex’s volume buckets and their $150 / 1M target. Please prep two slides for the pricing review: 
- Slide 1: Dedicated sizing + estimated unit cost with committed capacity (breakdown by GPU type, throughput)
- Slide 2: Hosted vs Dedicated blended $/1M for Scenario A (cost-optimized) and Scenario B (quality-first), include sensitivity to volume buckets (low/likely/high).

Priyom — can you model the caching & batching levers quickly (assume 25–35% savings on chat if we enable prefix caching + batching)? Rishi — please call out any latency SLO risks if we route more queries to quantized models.

I’ll book the 30-min slot for Tue 10am PST with BrightLayer.

— Marissa
